notes.title: KARNAL 1.5
notes.content:
Replaced the knife with a kicking ability.
 Ammo and sprinting are now infinite in the final level.
 Added a short level before exiting the facility to improve pacing.
 Added different backgrounds for the Settings and Lost Tapes menus.
 Fixed several bugs.
 Disabled texture streaming, as the performance gain was negligible.


This will be the final planned update for KARNAL, apart from any necessary bug fixes. I’ll now be focusing on a new game that I’ve been developing, as well as dedicating time to studying.

Thank you to everyone who played KARNAL!

notes.title: Karnal 1.4
notes.content:
Added the "Assisted" mode, which gives the player infinite stamina, a health & ammo counter, automatic reloading, and replaces the last level with an alternate ending.
Improved the UI a bit.
Padlocks are now interacted with using "E".

notes.title: Minor Changes & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Drastically reduced chromatic aberration.
Slightly reduced pixelation filter.
Removed some debugging text I accidentally left in.
Bug fixes.

notes.title: KARNAL 1.3.1
notes.content:
Enemies no longer shoot as they are dying.
Enemies no longer shoot instantly after spotting you.
The arena now has a smaller enemy limit.
Other small bug fixes.


Thank you to everyone who played this game and supported this little project.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed a bug where you sometimes couldn't get a certain achievement.

notes.title: KARNAL 1.3
notes.content:
Changes: 

Ammo is now limited. It is found for each weapon throughout the levels, and costs money in the arena.

Reworked the Enemy AI, no longer do they walk in a straight line towards you.

Drastically improved detail and changed the structure of the Story Mode levels.

Changed the menu fonts. 

Removed the option to disable Lumen. This was due to many levels now being very different with the feature turned off, possibly affecting gameplay. 

Drastically improved sound design. 

Added footstep sounds. 

Added roughness, metallic and normal maps to the player's weapon sprites. 

Added explosive barrels.

Added new post process effects. 

Added a few new secrets, alongside a new hidden achievement :)


And many more bug fixes, balancing changes, etc. 
The previous version, KARNAL 1.2 will be playable through the "Classic" branch.
